what: Corrected Dream tool-position conversion and matched the flat-pad closure limiter to collision geometry.
why: Recorded SDK joint solutions missed feasible Dream tool targets by centimetres; mismatched contact bounds could stop jaws before actual contact.
details: Constrained position-priority IK follows raw Dream EEF positions without object-pose input or a scripted lift, retains jaw predictions, and uses existing speed/joint limits. First live trial tracked position but dropped the block after 3.47 cm rise. A second recorded trial uses footprint-matched 3x2 cm flat pads. Model routing now recognizes a dropped block from current height, retaining the two-call full-model cap.
